{"m": "gpt-4o-mini", "msg": [{"content": "You extract the abstract relational skeleton of a single short anecdote. Focus on the pattern of intentions, causes, concealment, deception, reversals of appearance vs reality, and who is helped or harmed. Abstract away all surface details (names, jobs, objects, settings): use generic role labels like AGENT, TARGET, THIRD_PARTY.", "role": "system"}, {"content": "ANECDOTE:
As a teenager, I ghostwrote my pastor's sermons when he was overwhelmed. He delivered them as divine inspiration received in prayer. Years later, parishioners still quote 'his' words to me. I smile and nod while hearing my own sentences praised back to me.

Extract its relational skeleton. Respond as JSON with keys:
  "roles": list of generic role labels used (e.g. ["AGENT","TARGET"]),
  "relations": list of [source_role, predicate, target_role] triples,
      where predicate is chosen ONLY from this set: [intends, causes, prevents, enables, conceals, deceives, manufactures_threat, sacrifices_for, exploits, misattributes_credit, appears_positive, actually_negative, appears_negative, actually_positive, reverses_expectation, tests_loyalty, feigns_inability, protects_by_withholding, harms_by_helping, reveals_hidden_trait],
  "pattern": one abstract sentence describing the deep structure with no surface nouns.
Use only the allowed predicates. Do not mention the concrete topic.", "role": "user"}], "t": 0.0, "tag": "extract"}
content:
{
  "roles": ["AGENT", "TARGET", "THIRD_PARTY"],
  "relations": [
    ["AGENT", "intends", "TARGET"],
    ["AGENT", "enables", "TARGET"],
    ["AGENT", "conceals", "THIRD_PARTY"],
    ["AGENT", "deceives", "THIRD_PARTY"],
    ["THIRD_PARTY", "misattributes_credit", "AGENT"],
    ["THIRD_PARTY", "appears_positive", "TARGET"],
    ["TARGET", "actually_negative", "AGENT"]
  ],
  "pattern": "An agent enables a target while concealing and deceiving a third party, leading to misattributed credit and a positive appearance for the target, despite the agent's negative reality."
}
